newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $16.154 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $16.154 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $68 million, or 0.4 percent, in the week to June 9, to $16.154 billion, according to new figures released by the Central Bank on Thursday.
Reserves stood at $16.086 billion on June 2, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.

Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $975 million, or 6.4 percent. Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year, to $15.179 billion. Government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
